findings.title: Case and variant preserve the passive subject
findings.claim: The case of bahimah fixes the livestock-creature phrase as the subject receiving permission, so the passive is not a human authorization.
findings.mechanism: The nominative construct-head analysis and accepted variant boundary keep the subject role in place while the authorizer remains unspoken.
findings.reader_payoff: Permission is heard as something conferred on a concrete animal category.
findings.containment: This is a local case and voice relation; it does not activate every possible root sense.

epistemic.reason: The grammatical reading is grounded and the variant pressure is explicitly bounded.

findings.title: The creature term carries bounded opacity
findings.claim: Bahimah names the concrete creature class, while its opacity and speechlessness pressure makes the permitted animals appear as living beings rather than self-defining legal objects.
findings.mechanism: Root pressure meets the livestock construct and the case-selected subject, coloring the category without replacing it.
findings.reader_payoff: The animal category retains creaturely presence inside the legal grant.
findings.containment: The livestock construct restricts this coloration; no general claim about every bahima usage is made.

epistemic.reason: The root pressure is supplied and locally bounded by syntax and construct.

findings.title: One singular head gathers the permitted class
findings.claim: The singular construct head bahimah is the passive subject of permission and gathers the livestock phrase into one compact category.
findings.mechanism: The construct-head relation makes the first noun carry the subject role while the genitive term supplies its domain.
findings.reader_payoff: The permission is not a loose list of animals but a single grammatically organized category.
findings.containment: The finding concerns the local subject and construct relation only.

epistemic.reason: The supplied word analysis directly states the grammatical relation.

findings.title: The compound keeps livestock in a worship-regulated field
findings.claim: The compact animal-plus-livestock compound places the permitted category in a worship-regulated use field while still naming concrete livestock.
findings.mechanism: The singular construct head is narrowed by the livestock term, and the supplied lexical field connects that compound to regulated offering use.
findings.reader_payoff: The animals arrive as provision with a ritual boundary already audible around their use.
findings.containment: No external ayah comparison is asserted here; the claim is limited to the supplied lexical association in this focus phrase.

epistemic.reason: The lexical association is supplied, but its interpretive pressure is narrower than the primary animal reading.

findings.title: Favor arrives inside a sacred boundary
findings.claim: The livestock grant can register as favor, but the same local wording places that favor under divine authority and a sacred limit.
findings.mechanism: The provision term's favor pressure contacts the closing authority and the consecrated restriction, so benefit is not presented as unbounded access.
findings.reader_payoff: The grant feels generous without becoming unrestricted possession.
findings.containment: This is a local relation among supplied words; it does not assert a wider favor network.

epistemic.reason: The root coloration and local contacts are supplied, while the concrete livestock sense remains intact.

findings.title: The genitive term narrows the creature category
findings.claim: Al-anam narrows the broad creature head to a known livestock domain.
findings.mechanism: Its definite genitive position completes the construct and prevents the permission from expanding to every kind of beast.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see exactly which animal field the permission addresses.
findings.containment: The finding does not choose among the term's other lexical pressures beyond this construct-selected domain.

epistemic.reason: The supplied construct grammar directly performs this narrowing.

findings.title: Livestock is audible as provision
findings.claim: The livestock term carries provision and blessing pressure, so the permitted animals read as received provision rather than bare inventory.
findings.mechanism: The root's good-life and beneficence coloration meets the concrete genitive livestock sense.
findings.reader_payoff: The legal permission also registers as a gift whose use is being bounded.
findings.containment: The local construct controls the pressure as livestock provision; it is not a claim that every root branch is active.

epistemic.reason: The root coloration is explicitly supplied and narrowed by the local noun phrase.

findings.title: A recognized class is placed under rule
findings.claim: The definite collective plural presents livestock as a recognized managed class rather than as individually itemized animals.
findings.mechanism: Definiteness and plural breadth make the ruling operate over an established category while the construct keeps its domain specific.
findings.reader_payoff: The permission has class-wide legal scope without losing its livestock boundary.
findings.containment: This is a number and definiteness effect within the focus phrase, not an inventory of individual animals.

epistemic.reason: The supplied morphology directly supports the class reading.

findings.title: Permission contains its exclusion

findings.mechanism: The exception particle pivots directly from the lawful grant to content that will not enter it.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader no longer hears the permission as an unrestricted opening later corrected.

epistemic.reason: The supplied particle analysis directly states the internal boundary.

findings.title: The exception stages the legal movement
findings.claim: The ayah moves by stages from summons and command to permission, exception, restriction, and closing sovereignty.
findings.mechanism: The exception particle interrupts the grant at the point where the legal architecture turns from opening access to specifying its limits.
findings.reader_payoff: The clauses feel like one controlled legal progression rather than unrelated statements.
findings.containment: This sequence is confined to the supplied focus ayah and does not state a surah-wide architecture.

epistemic.reason: The staged relation is directly supplied by the local word analysis.

findings.title: The exception leaves a slot for recitation
findings.claim: The first ma leaves the excluded content open until the following recitation specifies what falls outside the grant.
findings.mechanism: The relative pronoun supplies an unresolved content position, and the passive recitation clause fills it through received wording.
findings.reader_payoff: The exception is understood as content-defined disclosure rather than an immediate list.
findings.containment: The finding does not invent the omitted content; it describes only the open grammatical slot and its supplied completion.

epistemic.reason: Both the relative slot and its recitation completion are supplied.

findings.title: The two relative slots echo one another

epistemic.reason: The two positions are supplied, while the interpretive parallel is a bounded relation.

findings.reader_payoff: The legal limit feels delivered and governed at once.

epistemic.reason: The parallel is supported by two local word analyses and remains interpretive rather than grammatical necessity.

findings.title: The passive keeps recitation in view

findings.mechanism: The passive imperfect supplies an ongoing or unfolding disclosure without naming its human agent.
findings.reader_payoff: The exception feels dependent on authoritative wording rather than on an arbitrary omission.

epistemic.reason: The voice, aspect, and omitted agent are directly supplied.

findings.title: Recitation follows and carries the boundary

findings.mechanism: The root's ordered-following coloration contacts the relative exception and the preceding permission.
findings.reader_payoff: The limitation is heard as traveling with the grant, not arriving as an unrelated interruption.
findings.containment: The root pressure colors the local sequence; it does not activate unrelated following or reading branches.

epistemic.reason: The local following relation is supplied as root pressure around a grammar-selected recitation sense.

findings.title: The disclosed limit falls on the audience

findings.title: The exception is a state restriction

findings.title: The exclusion gathers the local animal-law field

findings.mechanism: Ghayra excludes a role inside the same sequence that grants livestock and names hunt under sacred status.

findings.containment: The root pressure colors the selected state; it does not replace the grammatical predicate or activate every root use.

findings.reader_payoff: The state is felt as a compact, memorable closure to the hunting restriction.
findings.containment: The sound pressure is qualified evidence; it does not introduce a separate legal reading.
